concept: IAM: EC2 role (instance profile) instead of access keys
tests: How to give an application on EC2 access to S3 without storing long-term credentials on the instance.
expected: Attach an IAM role to EC2 (instance profile) with an S3 access policy — temporary credentials are delivered via instance metadata and rotated automatically. Trigger: "avoid storing long-term credentials".
why_not: IAM user + access keys, environment variables, user data — all put static long-lived keys on the instance.
